required_outcomes: Records the landlord's decision: no £600 quote; his own builders (Castlegate Builders) will clear the waste free of charge on Monday 7 April from 9am; levelling and gravel are declined.
Stands down the contractor route through Oakley in writing.

Gives the tenant written notice of the 7 April visit, saying it is the landlord's builders coming to clear the waste, asks them to confirm the side gate can be left open or access arranged, and tells them levelling and gravel will not be done.
Schedules a follow-up after 7 April to confirm with the tenant that the garden has been cleared, without assigning an agency contractor.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord for a contact at Castlegate Builders so the tenant knows who to expect, without delaying the notice.
Recording the visit date on the ticket, provided it is the landlord's builders and the date he gave.
positive_behaviours: Tells the landlord the tenant has been given notice and asks him to say if the date changes.
Notes that no invoice is expected through the agency for this work.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve again, or escalating a clear instruction.
Telling the tenant the date without saying who is coming.
prohibited_actions: Instructing an agency contractor or approving any spend.
Arranging access to the garden without notice to the tenant.
critical_failures: Leaving the tenant with no notice of the 7 April visit.
